items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: At various times these people were with Sidney... I'd be with this group here and in two or three weeks I'm with another one... Sidney had never worked with Red Richards, but somehow we contacted Red Richards to come and play with us

ctx.x: Yeah, in Sidney's group, who else was in his group in the late '40s?
Only Sidney and myself, Sammy Price, or Red Richards and Kansas Fields, or Arthur Trappier.
